newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Legend Q2 computer sales top 100,000.
newsitem.headline: China's Legend Q2 computer sales top 100,000.

text.p: China's Legend Group sold more than 100,000 computers in the second quarter of this year, up 154 percent from the year-ago period, a company official said on Monday.
That figure meant Legend retained its place as the top computer retailer in China, the official said in a telephone interview.
Sales of Legend computers reached 39,000 in June alone, setting a record for highest monthly sales, the official said.
The figures included sales of desktop computers, notebook computers and personal computer servers, he said but gave no further details.
The company sold 67,000 computers in the first quarter of this year, earlier figures showed.
The Legend Group has a Hong Kong-listed arm, Legend Holdings Ltd (Hong Kong).
